relations.rationale: Checking an attendance sheet has no bearing on members comparing locomotives.
Checking attendance is unrelated to Nell's competition ranking.
That everyone except two latecomers had arrived is consistent with and supports the claim that those latecomers were expected around noon.
The latecomers' expected arrival time has no logical connection to members lining up for sandwiches.
Finn being in Bo's class doesn't determine whether Bo shares a class with Nell.

The size and subject of the largest layout has no bearing on members comparing locomotives.
The largest layout's description is unrelated to Nell's competition ranking.

The layout's placement near the door is unrelated to Bo and Nell's class assignments.
Bo not being in Nell's class does not directly determine whether Finn is in Nell's class.
Class assignments among Bo and Nell have no bearing on refreshment table timing.

Zeno's steam engine display supports the general claim of a miniature world being present that attracted visitors.
